value.name: Miles sits distressed at desk
value.description: Miles sits behind his desk in a visibly shaken, haunted state, indicating he is emotionally unsettled.
evidence: Miles sits behind his desk, fingers steepled, staring at nothing, a haunted look on his face.

value.name: Intercom interrupts Miles
value.description: Miles is interrupted by his intercom, which announces an incoming message.

value.name: Miles refuses calls
value.description: Miles tells the caller not to put through any calls because he feels emotionally fragile.
evidence: MILES Please! No calls! I'm feeling very fragile.

value.name: Intercom announces Marylin Rexroth
value.description: The voice informs Miles that Marylin Rexroth wants to see him immediately.
evidence: VOICE I'm sorry, Mr. Massey, but I felt certain you'd want to know -- Marylin Rexroth wants to see you.

value.name: Miles reacts to Marylin's arrival
value.description: Miles repeats Marylin Rexroth's name in surprise, prompting clarification about her presence.
evidence: MILES Marylin Rexroth? When does she --
